other_conditions: Must be a permanent resident of Assam
Must obtain the housing loan from any Scheduled Commercial Bank, Regional Rural Bank, or Assam Cooperative Apex bank within Assam
Total family income must not exceed ₹20,00,000
Loan amount must be more than ₹5,00,000 and up to ₹40,00,000, sanctioned on or after 1st April 2019
Loan accounts must not be under NPA (Non Performing Assets) status
Must be the first home for the composite family and not have availed loans under the previous Apun Ghar Scheme
benefits_summary: Subsidy of up to ₹2,50,000 on home loans ranging from ₹5,00,000 to ₹40,00,000.
